title: Rona na sakina
body:
Rona na sakina
Haaye sakina..(4)
Shabe ashoor choti shehzadi se kehte the husain
meri jaan sakina..
<<MINI>>
tum baad mere dekho yu rona na sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
amma hi ki aaghosh me sojana sakina
<<MINI>>
tum baad mere dekho yu rona na sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Allah kisi beti ko dikhlaye na wo ghum
jo ghum tumhe khud deke chale jaenge kal hum
kal tumko na mil payega ye baba ka seena
<<MINI>>
tum baad mere dekho yu rona na sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ye baat ghanimat hai tere waste beta
seene pe mere chayn se soja meri dukhiya
kal khaak me mil jaega zehra ka nagina
<<MINI>>
tum baad mere dekho yu rona na sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ek baat mai samjhata hu ae beti abhi se
shikwa nahi karna kabhi amma se, phuphi se
sone ke liye raat ko zidd karna kabhi na
<<MINI>>
tum baad mere dekho yu rona na sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kehte hai jise daaghe yatimi meri dukhiya
kal sar pe tere baap ka saaya na rahega
ye ehle sitam tujhe ab dikhlaege keena
<<MINI>>
tum baad mere dekho yu rona na sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mangunga dua mai teri khatir ye khuda se
mehfooz rakhe wo tujhe har ranjo bala se
raas aaye safar, aaye safar ka ye mehina
<<MINI>>
tum baad mere dekho yu rona na sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jo dard tujhe denge laee mai bhi sahunga
tum naaqe pe aur barsare naiza mai chalunga
waada hai akela tumhe chodunga kabhi na
<<MINI>>
tum baad mere dekho yu rona na sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hojayegi tu qaid teri aaho buka bhi
madar bhi teri, phuphiya bhi aur zainul eba bhi
tumko usi zindaan me sona hai sakina
<<MINI>>
tum baad mere dekho yu rona na sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ae mazhar o irfan qayamat hai y e jumle
maa baap sada saath nahi rehte kisi ke
sheh kehte the ab seekh lo bin baap ke jeena
<<MINI>>
tum baad mere dekho yu rona na sakina..(2)
